name: FA_MC_BOOKS_RATES
description: FA_MC_BOOKS _RATES contains exchange rate information that Oracle Assets uses to convert transaction amounts in the primary book to the reporting currencies in the reporting books. Oracle Assets creates a row in this table for each reporting book for the following asset transaction types: ADDITION, CIP ADDITION, ADJUSTMENT and CIP ADJUSTMENT.

columns.name: INVOICE_TRANSACTION_ID
columns.description: Unique identifier of the invoice transaction.

columns.name: COST
columns.description: Total recorded cost of the asset.

columns.name: EXCHANGE_RATE
columns.description: Rate used for converting amounts between primary currency and reporting currency.

columns.name: AVG_EXCHANGE_RATE
columns.description: Weighted average exchange rate based on the prior cost and current cost of the asset.

columns.name: COMPLETE
columns.description: Completion status of conversion to reporting currency of all the transaction amounts.

columns.name: CREATION_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the creation of the row.

columns.name: CREATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who created the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the last update of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_LOGIN
columns.description: Who column: indicates the session login associated to the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: OBJECT_VERSION_NUMBER
columns.description: Used to implement optimistic locking. This number is incremented every time that the row is updated. The number is compared at the start and end of a transaction to detect whether another session has updated the row since it was queried.
